items.description: Yes, Vault is fully regulated in the US as an MSB and holds multiple international licenses for digital asset custody.

items.title: How long does verification take?
items.description: Our automated KYC system verifies 90% of retail users in under 60 seconds using advanced biometric matching.

items.title: What are the staking rewards?
